assets.prompt:
Use case: editorial illustration-story.
Asset type: WeChat article lead image and horizontal cover, approximately 2.35:1 wide.
Primary request: A sophisticated magazine illustration for a Chinese personal AI product observation column about Hex 4.0: turning AI conversations about data into a tangible, inspectable analytical app.
Scene: Off-white desk-like editorial space. A large beautiful translucent emerald dashboard panel with understated abstract bar charts and a small filter control, linked to a conversational bubble and a small magnifying lens revealing layered data lineage under the chart. These are abstract visual metaphors, not a reproduction of the real Hex interface. A small human hand adjusts a filter to show human agency. No robot mascot, no humanoid AI, no glowing brain, no fake screenshot.
Composition: Strong central subject with restrained whitespace, safe central crop for 1:1 sharing, crisp silhouettes, wide cinematic editorial composition. The chart, lens, and hand form one cohesive scene rather than disconnected cards.
Style: Refined dimensional vector editorial illustration, subtle paper grain and soft tactile shading, clean tasteful technology publication aesthetic. Dark pine green, warm ivory, muted terracotta accents. Premium and calm, not a course diagram or promotional poster.
Exact typography: Only the small understated text "Hex 4.0", clean bold dark green sans-serif. No other text, no badge, no watermark, no company logo.
Constraints: No factual numbers, no performance claims, no fabricated product controls. Visually distinguish concept art from product screenshot. Flat light ivory background. All important elements comfortably within the central 75 percent.
